title: Four psychic groups of ETs (friends/enemies, more/less psychic)

tellings.quote: The friends who are less or equal to us psychically come here for trade.

plain: Aliens visiting Earth fall into four groups, according to a former Army sergeant and psychic spy named Lyn Buchanan: friends or enemies, each either more or less psychically gifted than humans. Buchanan says this came from his own work in the 1980s and a paper comparing human and alien psychic ability, and he tells Michels that 'the friends who are less or equal to us psychically come here for trade.' It is offered as a map of who is coming here and why.
